title: Reliance Stock Jumps 2.6% As Jio Platforms ₹30,200 Crore IPO Opens For Subscription
description: Reliance Industries shares rose 2.68% on Oct 21 as Jio Platforms opened its ₹30,200 crore IPO for subscription. title: Sydney man arrested after allegedly telling AI chatbot he planned a mass shooting at a childcare centre
description: A 29-year-old man has been remanded in custody for a mental health assessment after authorities were alerted to an alleged threat made during a conversation with Claude, an artificial intelligence chatbot. The case has raised questions about AI safety, online threats and how technology companies respond to potentially dangerous conversations.
content:
